qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High customer switching costs and prohibitive qualification/recertification barriers (FAA, FDA, ISO) across aerospace, medtech, and laboratory testing lock in customers, enabling steady 2-3% pricing power above inflation with zero churn. 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 14.1% and operating margins expanding from 20.6% in 2016 to 25.8% in 2025 confirm moat durability against customer consolidation or industrial cyclicality.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier niche instrumentation and precision electromechanical compounder with unassailable switching costs across aerospace, medtech, and automation. High pricing power demonstrated by consistent 2-3% annual price increases with zero churn. Highly resilient across all 5 macrotrends with negligible capex needs (<2% of sales) and fortress balance sheet (interest coverage >23x, net debt/EBITDA <0.8x). [5-10Y g: organic volume 3.0% + niche pricing power 2.5% + bolt-on M&A reinvestment 2.5% - cost/integration drag 0.5% + share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 14.1% and operating ROIC >200% on tangible capital. Unbroken 10-year Owner EPS CAGR of 10.96% ($2.69 in 2016 to $7.67 in 2025) demonstrating pristine peak-to-peak compounding through the 2020 pandemic. FCF conversion averages 107.6% of net income with capex under 1.8% of sales ($130M on $7.4B revenue). Segment revenue split: Electronic Instruments Group (~70% of sales) and Electromechanical Group (~30% of sales). Highly disciplined M&A playbook proven by rapid deleveraging following the $1.9B Paragon Medical acquisition in late 2023, reducing net debt from $2.9B to under $1.7B in 2024 and net debt to 0.42x annual net income by 2025. Interest coverage stands at a fortress 23.5x ($1,910M EBIT vs $81M interest expense).
